richiami.difetto: A manufacturing defect exists in a production batch of front brake master cylinder components which MV AGUSTA has installed on a series of F4 RR and F4 RC model motorcycles. The defect in the front brake master cylinder could cause it to malfunction during normal use of the motorcycle leading to a loss of front braking ability and increasing the risk of a crash. Specifically crack generation on the front brake master cylinder PPS (polyphenilene sulphide) piston connecting the internal pressure area to the external surface. The consequence is that the front brake may not participate in stopping the bike properly. The rear brake is not affected and works correctly.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the synthetic piston in the front brake master cylinder with one made from aluminium machined from solid billet guaranteeing a higher strength material as well as eliminating the possibility of porosity.
richiami.titolo: THE FLOATING PISTON IN THE FRONT BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER MAY CRACK

richiami.difetto: A potentially defective rear wheel rim has been installed on some motorcycles.  The rear wheel rim has spokes that may become loose and eventually cause the wheel to fail. If the spokes are loose or become loose the wheel may react abnormally causing the motorcycle to wobble when ridden thus increasing the nsk of an accident.
richiami.modello: BRUTALE 800 DRAGSTER RR , BRUTALE 800 DRAGSTER RR
richiami.rimedio: Recall the seven possibly affected machines and replace the rear wheel rim.
richiami.titolo: DEFECTIVE REAR WHEEL RIM CAN ALLOW SPOKES TO LOOSEN AND CAUSE THE WHEEL TO FAIL

richiami.difetto: The rear shock absorber piston rod nut may come loose. The shock absorber performance may be affected possibly causing a loss of machine control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the shock absorber..
richiami.titolo: REAR SHOCK ABSORBER MAY FAIL CAUSING LOSS OF CONTROL OF THE MACHINE

richiami.rimedio: Recall all the affected machines and replace the swing arm mounting bolt.
richiami.titolo: MACHINE MAY BECOME UNSTABLE AND INCREASE THE RISK OF A CRASH

richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected machines and fit replacement supports.
